name: PhilRX
desc:
Partner Support Specialist | $20-$24/hr | Admin/Data Entry, No Sales Expectations
Company: Phil
Industry: Healthcare Technology / Prescription Management and Pharmacy Network Support
What Your Day Will Look Like: Phil connects doctors, pharmacies, and patients so prescriptions get filled and delivered faster. You'd work behind the scenes with the pharmacies in Phil's partner network, making sure prescriptions are processed correctly and on time. That means answering internal escalation requests, entering data and processing requests for regional partners, and contacting pharmacies when something is holding up an order. When a prescription gets stuck, you'd dig into what went wrong, fix the error, and get it moving again. You'd also help with the monthly financial reconciliations for partner pharmacies and talk with partners about turnaround times and how to improve. You'd work with the finance, warehouse, engineering, and patient support teams along the way.
assessment: Likely. Prior authorization employers commonly use assessments focused on healthcare terminology, insurance knowledge, attention to detail, multitasking, and computer navigation skills.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
Required Experience: Prior pharmacy technician experience or direct experience working with prescription-related workflows is required. 2+ years of experience in administrative support, operations, customer support, or a related field.
Preferred Experience: Experience working with external clients or partners. Experience with G Suite applications.
Required Skills:
Strong attention to detail with solid organization and time management
Self-motivated and able to manage daily and weekly tasks independently
Ability to learn operational workflows and find root causes quickly
Clear, professional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication
Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-growing startup
G Suite and shared document collaboration for remote work
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone who has worked as a pharmacy technician or in a pharmacy setting and wants a remote, behind-the-scenes role
Someone who likes tracking down why something got stuck and fixing it
Someone detail-oriented who can handle data entry and reconciliation work accurately
Someone comfortable with change, since the company is a fast-growing startup
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone with no pharmacy or prescription workflow experience, since that is required outright
Anyone who needs a slow-paced, highly structured environment
Anyone outside the approved remote state list
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Pharmacy technician experience
Prescription workflow processing
Data entry accuracy
Order escalation triage and resolution
Partner and vendor communication
Financial reconciliation support
Root cause analysis
Cross-functional collaboration
Google Workspace collaboration
Independent workflow management
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your pharmacy or prescription workflow experience.
Walk us through how you'd figure out why a prescription is stuck and get it moving again.
How do you stay accurate doing data entry and reconciliation work?
Tell us about a time you worked with an outside partner to fix a problem.
How do you handle a fast-changing environment where processes aren't always set yet?

Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $20 to $24/hr, confirmed in posting. Pay depends on experience.
Shift: Full-time. Hours and time zone are not stated in the posting, confirm directly.
Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus an opportunity to contribute to a 401(k).
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: Oklahoma is on the approved remote state list (AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, MA, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV). Phil is a Series D startup, so the posting calls it a ground floor opportunity, and the role will likely change as the company grows. The pharmacy experience requirement is the real gate, so this fits a participant who has worked as a pharmacy technician or in another pharmacy role, not general customer service alone.
Career Pathway: Not stated in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Partner Support Specialist → Senior Partner Support Specialist → Partner Operations Lead → Partner Pharmacy Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Phil directly.
